title: aniba permollis
intro: Aniba permollis, commonly known as Oreganillo, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lauraceae. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against diseases and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Aniba permollis include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-parasitic, and anti-hemorrhagic agent, making it useful in the treatment of wounds, infections, and other health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Aniba permollis include sesquiterpenes, including permollisol, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
